name: Stonecutter Woodworks
summary: Use the stonecutter for wood: turn planks into stairs, slabs, fences, doors and more, one block at a time.
logoPrompt: A stonecutter block with its round saw blade spinning, a neat stack of wooden planks beside it and fresh wood shavings flying from the blade

cover.tagline: Cut wood like stone, one plank at a time.

description: **Stonecutter Woodworks lets the stonecutter cut wood: put planks in and pick exactly the block you need, one at a time.**
- Turns planks into stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors, trapdoors and pressure plates.
- Covers oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove and cherry.
- One plank gives two slabs or one of every other block, close to the crafting table amounts.
- No more leftover stairs when you only needed three.
Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). Then place a stonecutter and put planks into it.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only adds recipes, so it is safe to add to or remove from an existing world.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers; players need nothing installed.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
